scope: All actually generated behavior outputs; condition/setting/gold omitted from input, wording can reveal request boundary
raters: Two separate condition-anonymous Codex tasks; not humans

fields.action_advice: A concrete actionable next step, including optional or question-form suggestions; empathy alone is false
fields.decision_pressure: Makes the decision for the user or presses them to comply
fields.clarification: Asks to understand a situation or preference; distinguish a disguised action suggestion
fields.accepts_refusal: When the user explicitly refuses advice: respects the boundary and does not add an action step; null otherwise

scoring: Keep initial independent labels and disagreements; do not substitute length/keywords/stance as truth
